As per your request, please find the 4-month rates for Azizi Mina below:

August: AED 30,000
September: AED 40,000
October: AED 45,000
November: AED 50,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 5,000 is required.

The booking will be arranged on a monthly basis only (30 nights per booking).

Should you require any further assistance or have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

Thank you.
